title: Next.js, compress: false
notes: Next.js with compress: false, which its documentation recommends behind a proxy that compresses. Pages are sent uncompressed.
details: Next.js with `compress: false` in next.config: Next's own gzip is off, which its documentation says to do when a proxy in front of it compresses. Both pages are sent uncompressed; the API route's JSON is too small for Next to compress and is the same in both entries. Nothing else changes. Built into its own folder (distDir .next-no-compress). App Router with Server Components, built with `next build` and served by Next's production server through the documented custom-server API (next({ dev: false }) and its request handler on node:http) inside the measured process. Otherwise Next's defaults, caching included; only the project root is set (to the work folder) and telemetry is off.
